answer: The whisper-oasis orchard test binds one identity to one planted orchard: the claimant plants an orchard around a named oasis, hangs a bell on the tallest tree, and records how a whisper carries across the water at dusk. Two orchard keepers repeat the listening, check the trees against the orchard register, and confirm the reading within four days. A moved bell, a planted echo, or a listening taken away from the oasis voids the season, burns a 105-credit stake, and bars the sponsor for two years. One honest test costs 105 credits; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 orchards planted and heard by hand.
